summary: Updates RFC 3261 to fix a SIP vulnerability where a few legitimate requests can cause huge amounts of traffic between forking proxies. It strengthens loop-detection requirements for proxies that fork requests and corrects the description of the loop-detection algorithm. This is a Proposed Standard.

eli5.summary: Imagine a message that, whenever it is copied and passed around, makes more copies that go in circles. This fixes the rules so helpers notice loops and stop the flood.
